title: Category:Builds
html:
Many things in the game are hard to do, such as farming a boss efficiently, grinding XP quickly, killing fast in PvP and loads more. Most people make Builds to be good and better at one single thing. For example:

  • A Ranger has several different choices among skills. Which is better, loads of Poison spells, or going for weapon critical skill?
  • Which spells work best for a Mage? How can skills and equipment be combined in the best way?
  • How does a fighter combine Melee skills with weapons and armor? Should a fighter count on magical skills or spells?
  • Does the same build work for PvE and solo PvP??

A Build can also refer to a combination of players for a PvE group or a PvP team. For example:

PvE: A group with Fighters, Rangers, Mages and perhaps Hybrids of the right levels who can work together.

PvP:

  • 5 level 40's are going to PvP against 5 level 30's.
  • The level 40's are random and don't work together, while the level 30's work together, and have a Build
  • Most likely the level 30 group will win. Why? They work together, as one does poison and fire damage, another does divine damage and another one slows the opponents down.

This are typical examples of Builds. Sometimes it's hard to make your own Builds. Now The Townstons have a solution. We will put Builds here along with a page of Stat Choices, that can be used in whatever way you like. If someone Submits a build, they should note how much it has been tested. Unless it says otherwise, Builds here have only been tested by the submitter. Unless you are well known to Builds and if they work, it is recommeded that you use caution in selecting a Build.
